name: Guangdong Xinbao Electrical Appliances Holdings Co., Ltd
summary: Guangdong Xinbao Electrical Appliances Holdings Co., Ltd engages in the production and sale of small household appliances in China and internationally. It offers kitchen appliances, such as coffee machine, air fryer, electric kettle, electric oven, eggbeater, kitchen center, baking plate, juicer, hand blender, toaster, and bread machine; and home appliances, including steam station and brush, electric iron, air purifier, humidifier, and vacuum cleaner.
